implementation_scope: This first deliverable freezes the scientific and operational contract, tests density accounting and the archived spectrum conversion, and supplies a typed numerical-target descriptor. A physical executor and a full observational qualifier are not implemented or authorized by this deliverable.
purpose: A separately identified accuracy2 posterior from the exact same original proposal chains and all2000selectedslots, only if a genuine surviving1to2 numerical density variation is established and the same32point2to3screen and accuracy2replay pass.
unchanged_science: Same full native likelihood components, priors, sampled physical/nuisance coordinates, SN release/evolution/calibration choice, neutrino/flatness/halofit settings, lens_potential_accuracy4, lens_margin and finalized multipole requirements. No acoustic-scale reinversion or change to the posterior prior. No sampler/proposal rerun.
selection: Preserve every original selected slot, order, chain group, point, RLE source row, expanded_index, storedproposal density and originalnative1 record. Nondecreasing chronological indices and duplicate selected slots are valid; no deduplication, redraw, replacement or trimming.
prerequisites: Fresh original measurement_summary.summarize_run passes and binds all original chain, source, asset, environment, selectedpoint and native1record identities.

Fresh native_precision_review_consumer.verify(screen,thermal_review) passes and reconstructs all32original records. Require reviewed_screen_status numerical_sensitivity_requires_followup with genuine total/componentdensity flags only, no unresolved record/density failure. Preserve the original failed auxiliary-background flags as historical status.

Reconstruct and verify the native_precision_refinement plan, successfulaccuracy2 replay record/ledger, all32 same-selectedpoint accuracy3records and report. Require no_large_variation_detected_on_fixed32, no failures/diagnosticflags, zero unknown-count attempts,32 recorded refinementinvocations and one recorded replayinvocation. Recompute the original spread summary rather than trusting a status field.

The full native accuracy2 configuration exactly equals the original high2 screen configuration; reversing only the three boosts gives the original nativeaccuracy1 configuration. Source/version/data identities must agree, including GPU-first factory routing when required by the parent.
Frozen current synthetic validation passes with zero model/background/spectrum calls, including originalimportancegate failure controls and validatedDl-to-rawCl convention.

A separately authorized source-frozen persistent-worker replay/timing pilot passes before launching the full pool. A successful single fresh-process replay alone is insufficient to certify cache/order equivalence.
target_identity: Hash the canonical actual nativeaccuracy2configuration, accuracyvalue, parent physical/nuisance target lineage, unchanged data/assets/versions, new implementation/design hashes, spectrum convention, prerequisite evidence and persistentpilot contract. Keep proposal_target_identity, nativeaccuracy1identity and nativeaccuracy2identity distinct. Do not overwrite old settings/manifests or merely rename a report.
density_equation: logw2=logp_native2-logp_proposal=logw1+logp_native2-logp_native1. Preserve and compare allthree terms independently. The original stored native1 and proposal values remain immutable. Native2 priors must reproduce the native1 inferred prior and the same configured priors; no renormalization, clipping or smoothing of raw weights.
derived_values: Use nativeaccuracy2derived values, including rdrag,omegam,q/j and sn_chi2, never copied native1 derived values. The typed qualifier returns these together with the actual accuracy2config/identity and unchanged sampled coordinates. Accuracy1 background helpers may not consume the result by filename substitution.
reuse32: Reuse the32original high2 likelihood/prior/posterior/derived records only after full current source/config/assets/point/prior/component/spectrum hash equality and repaired auxiliary status review. Retain original status and failedchecks beside the reuse decision. No absent high2field may be silently replaced by a native1 value. Convert archivedDl to rawCl with the tested installedprovider convention; preserve originalNPZ and conversionprovenance. A failed conversion blocks reuse and the cohort; it does not authorize recomputation.

spectrum_archive.new: provider.get_Cl(ell_factor=False,units=FIRASmuK2), archived explicitly as raw Cl with the providerunit contract. tt/ee/bb/te are in FIRASmicrokelvin squared; pp is dimensionless C_phi_phi, not convergence power.
spectrum_archive.conversion: For ell>=1, multiply temperature/polarization Dl by2pi/[ell(ell+1)] and potentialDl by2pi/[ell(ell+1)]^2. Preserve pp atell0. Require tt/ee/bb/te ell0 exactlyzero because providerunit treatment there otherwise makes inversion ambiguous without additional state. Never infer physical lmax from padded archive length.

persistent_pilot.authorization: Not authorized by this design; requires explicit root allocation after source freeze and prerequisite evidence.
persistent_pilot.selection: Original32screen audit_indices0 and31, selected before outcomes. Worker0 requests0,31,0,31; worker1 requests31,0,31,0. Compare everyresult against originalhigh2records and earlier equalpoint results. No other point selection or fitting.
persistent_pilot.initialization: One native2model per process, configured identically to the screened source. No unrecorded warmup or background-only thermal substitution. Cache-hit invocations remain counted separately from instrumented native solver calls, if available.
persistent_pilot.required_checks: Allcomponents,priors,totalpost,derivedvalues,rawspectra,finalizedmultipoles and settings must meet the unchanged refinementreplay tolerances. Record modelconstruction and per-request timings. A state/order discrepancy blocks persistent execution; do not silently warm/clearcache/change targets to obtain agreement.

future_executor.processes: Persistent spawned process pool, configurable1to4workers, allOMP/BLAS thread counts1 and CLIPY_NOJAX1. One verified native2model per worker, cached across its requests. No automatic worker retry or task resubmission.
future_executor.accounting: All2000selectedslots receive records;32 reuse oldhigh2records withzero newcalls. Remaining1968 each reserve a one-use coordinator ticket and atomically exclusive worker claim before density invocation. Count modelconstruction, logposteriorinvocations, known auxiliary backgrounds and any unknown interruptedcall count separately. Do not label invocations as exact internal CAMBsolver calls.
future_executor.failure: Existing completed records are verified/replayed; any ticket/claim/log without a sealedcompleted record consumes its attempt and is not retried. Broken pool, invaliddensity, nonfinite derived values, spectrum mismatch or interrupted worker preserves failures and blocks qualification; no dropped/replaced points. Every previously sealedfilehash must verify before reuse, and no manifest may reseal changedpayloads.
future_executor.record: Each row binds selectedslot,chain/chronology,originalpoint and native1/proposaldensities, native2configidentity, completecomponent/prior/derived values, both logweight constructions/closure, rawCls+hash+metadata, originalreuse status or one-useattempt identities, process/session IDs and callcounts. Use canonical payload seals plus an immutable fullfile ledger.
future_executor.full_check: Reverify source/assets/versions, parent qualification and all32screen/refinement/pilot evidence before creating a plan and at finalization. Immutable cache and summary paths must be distinct from every original result.

qualification: A new native_accuracy_measurement qualifier must freshly replay the original parent and all prerequisites, exact native2configuration/identity, all2000sealedrecords and spectra, allfilehashes and weight algebra. Invoke unchanged exact_correction.summarize/weight_diagnostics with original thresholds and chronology, requiring all minpoint,ESS,Pareto-k,perchainmass/perchainESS,chainmean and10/20/40batch gates. Return an explicitly typed accuracy2target and native2derived posterior only on success. Failed outputs retain diagnostic fields and posterior=null. Never pass them through the old accuracy1consumer by changing filenames.
screen_limit: A successful fixed32point2to3screen supports this numerical target choice but is not proof of global accuracy2convergence. Full2000importancequalification does not establish missingmode coverage or empirical modeladequacy.
downstream: No expansion, luminosity, calibration, lensing, omission or manuscript consumer is adapted here. Each later consumer must explicitly accept the typed numericaltarget and use its actual settings and native2records; existing targets and outputs remain unchanged.
